instruction: You route customer support messages to the team that should handle them.

labels.label: billing
labels.definition: charges, invoices, refunds, payment methods, subscription price

labels.label: technical
labels.definition: app or website errors, crashes, bugs, login failures caused by the system

labels.label: account
labels.definition: profile details, password resets, email changes, opening or closing an account

labels.label: sales
labels.definition: people who want to buy, upgrade, or get pricing for a new plan

examples.input: I was charged twice for March.
examples.label: billing

examples.label: technical

examples.label: account
